coverage.equipmentPermit: Real Safety UI creates an EquipmentInspection and Permit. The SUP inspection fails and keeps equipment unavailable; Permit activation receives an atomic 409 with no status/version mutation. CON requests reinspection; SUP records current certificate/calibration refs, passes the inspection, and then activates the Permit against the exact Asset ref.
coverage.stopPermitResume: Real Safety UI creates/activates a Permit and creates a Stop affecting its exact WorkItem ref. CON acknowledges the Stop and links the current Action ref. CON submits corrective evidence and cause through the Action UI; SUP verifies it. CON requests Stop resume with evidence; SUP verifies against a current passed Inspection and explicitly lifts the Stop. The Permit remains suspended/workAuthorized=false after lift. CON separately requests Permit resume and SUP approves; only then it becomes active/workAuthorized=true.
coverage.authorizationAndIdempotency: UI-issued workflow commands are checked for expectedVersion and an Idempotency-Key. Workflow mutations for EquipmentInspection, Permit, Stop, and Action use the browser UI against the self-hosted HTTP API. Workspace, fixture, and available-action reads use authenticated HTTP GETs.

fixtureBoundary.preexistingDemoWorkflowInputs: The Stop scenario reads the demo project's existing in-progress Action and passed Inspection.
